description: Enumerate active reviewed topic identities, including topics whose answers are currently held. A topic has at least one current native-content and reference-scope pin in the requested locale. reviewedQuestionCount counts these mapped questions; it is coverage, not current answer availability. Each object also carries answerCount: distinct questions with a currently available whole answer in the requested locale, counted over pinned cells (current native-content pin plus reference-scope pin), not variants, sources or articles. Held cells, including native_public_scope_held, are excluded from counts rather than failing the page. Limit is an upper bound: counted pages emit at most 4 objects and at most 64 candidate pairs, both over pinned cells only. Follow nextCursor until null; total counts matching reviewed topics, not answers. Only the selected page's answers are read. A completed source or policy hold can yield answerCount:0 without erasing the topic. Counts are observed in one read-only snapshot per page at countObservedAt; pages are not one shared snapshot. Invalid cursors return an error; only operational failures (projection resource caps, a stale or mismatched snapshot, a read error) return {error, reason: count_unavailable}, never partial or stale numbers. A pin does not establish current law or personal applicability.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the exact nextCursor returned by the previous call. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: Requested upper bound; default 100, maximum 250. Counted pages return at most 4 objects and may be shorter to respect the 64 candidate-pair budget over pinned cells; follow nextCursor.

type.description: Filter by object type, e.g. state, program, regime, bank, legal_form.

name: answer_objects

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

answerCount.description: Currently available whole question cells in this locale; zero means every reviewed cell is held.

provenance.description: Origin of one record: stable id, clean canonical URL, publisher, the exact published revision served, a ready citation, primary sources and review status.

id.description: <locale>:<slug> for an article, <dataset>:<record id> for a dataset row.

version.description: Revision of exactly the material served: for an article the snapshot content hash (the HTML ETag value); for a dataset record the dataset revision it was published in, not the published filename. Null when unknown.

reviewedQuestionCount.description: Distinct current questions with reviewed native-content and reference-scope pins; this is mapped coverage, not availability.

total.description: Every active reviewed topic matching the type filter, including currently held topics, across all pages.

title: List reviewed native topics
